title: The Last Horn
summary: Dawn on Day six brings a sound from the harbour, and a hard truth from Mr. Hale.

beats.text: Day six. At dawn, a horn sounded from the harbour.
One long note. Pier Four. The boat was leaving.
We were still on nine, with four floors of them below us.
Leo dropped onto the couch. "So that was our ride," he said.
Mrs. Okafor turned her radio on, very low.

beats.speaker: announcer
beats.text: "Another boat leaves in three days," said the Harbor Station voice. "Last departure."
Three days. I counted our supplies twice.
The walkie-talkie hissed. Hale again, closer now.

beats.speaker: hale
beats.text: "I was the one who tapped once," he whispered. "I am hiding on the fourth floor."

beats.speaker: hale
beats.text: "I can take you to the roof. But the door below me just came open."
Then Biscuit stood up, stared at our door, and began to growl.
